device_name: AMD Radeon Pro W7900 Dual Slot
notes: Initial scaffold from Stage 4. The infrastructure is wired (CalibrationData reads this file; wave-calibrate-report tool diffs it against the LLVM SISchedule.td defaults) but the per-class isolation campaign is still pending. The single composite measurement we have today (vmem_store_loop_timed.mlir: ~59 cycles per scf.for body iter, comprising 1x buffer_store_b32 + 1x v_add_nc_u32 + s_add_i32 + s_cmp_lt_i32 + s_cbranch_scc1) is NOT a per-class number and is intentionally left out of overrides until a dedicated per-class kernel suite lands (tracked separately).
